vet_burn.text: You saw it, Captain. We burned him with the necromancer.
He was ours. He deserved ground.
Ground is where that thing reaches. Ash it can't. Nothing left to reincarnate.
First command and you still flinch at the pyre. Good. Stop flinching and you're the one we burn.

vet_horse.text: The blue roan walked off. Jaxx. Nobody's chasing it.
A horse that size, someone should.
A horse that size chooses. You don't tame a Clydesdale, Captain. You get chosen or you get trampled.
It'll be at the treeline by now. Following whatever it follows.

vet_captain.text: Four waves and you kept the line. Junior captain, first command.
Siphoned enough to keep the flame going. Riders noticed. Doesn't mean they'll drink with you.

bar.text: On the house, Captain. Door's behind you if the room gets loud.

door.text: Cold out. And that flame in my hand hasn't gone out since the pyre.
